explanation: A specific area or location where God commands that offerings and worship should take place.
An act in which something is given to God as a gift, thanksgiving, or to seek his favor.
Symbolizes life in the Bible and is an important part of many sacrificial acts.
False gods or objects that people worship instead of the true God.
To remove completely, often used in connection with eliminating idolatry and evil practices.
Land or property given by God to the tribes of Israel as part of his promise.
